# Sibship Pedigrees

```{r}
qc5 <- read.table("Affy550K_qc5.fam", colClasses = "character")
qc5_ped <- qc5 %>% 
    select(PEDNO = V1, IID = V2, FATHER_ID = V3, MOTHER_ID = V4) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(NUCID = case_when(FATHER_ID == 0 & MOTHER_ID == 0 ~ IID,
                             FATHER_ID != 0 & MOTHER_ID == 0 ~ FATHER_ID,
                             FATHER_ID == 0 & MOTHER_ID != 0 ~ MOTHER_ID,
                             .default = paste0(c(FATHER_ID, MOTHER_ID), collapse = "_"))) %>%
    ungroup()

pedno_to_nucid <- qc5_ped %>% select(OLD_FID = PEDNO, OLD_IID = IID, NEW_FID = NUCID, NEW_IID = IID)
snipar_ibd_ped <- qc5_ped %>% select(FID = NUCID, IID, FATHER_ID, MOTHER_ID)

write.table(pedno_to_nucid, file = "pedno_to_nucid.txt", row.names = F, quote = F)
write.table(snipar_ibd_ped, file = "snipar_ibd_ped.txt", row.names = F, quote = F)
```

```{bash}
## All chromosomes
~/plink1.9/plink \
  --bfile Affy550K_qc5 \
  --update-ids pedno_to_nucid.txt \
  --make-bed \
  --out Affy550K_qc6_nucid
 
## Split by chromosome
for chr in {1..22}; do ~/plink1.9/plink \
  --bfile Affy550K_qc6_nucid \
  --chr $chr \
  --make-bed \
  --out split_sets/Affy550K_qc6_nucid_chr$chr; \
done
```

# Sib IBD Segments

```{bash Run ibd.py}
conda activate SNIPar_GP2_py38
PLINK_SETS=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_plink/Affy550K_QC_Sets/split_sets
IBD_PED=~/sniparV2_analysis/sniparV2_unipar_plink/Affy550K_QC_Sets/snipar_ibd_ped.txt

chnum=21
ibd.py \
  --bed ${PLINK_SETS}/Affy550K_qc6_nucid_chr@ \
  --chr_range 21 \
  --pedigree ${IBD_PED} \
  --map genetic_maps.b37/chr${chnum}.b37.gmap.txt \
  --min_maf 0.02 \
  --out sniparV2_analysis/unipar_ibd/ \
  --threads 10
```
